Plays the channels of a bus that [PauseAudioBus](PauseAudioBus) paused on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
ResumeAudioBus world
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap A channel that [PauseChannel](PauseChannel) paused on its own stays paused, and so does a channel on a bus that feeds a paused bus.
